ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT.DESCRIPTION_UNKNOWN_AGENT: Another agent is already handling this conversation. Ask them to release it, or ask an administrator to reassign it.

WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_CONNECTION.NOT_CONNECTED: WhatsApp is not connected. Please link your device again.
WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_CONNECTION.NOT_CONNECTED_CONTACT_ADMIN: WhatsApp is not connected. Click this button to try to reconnect, or please contact your administrator to link your device again.
WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_CONNECTION.RECONNECT_FAILED: Failed to reconnect. Please contact your administrator to link your device again.

WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_CONNECTION.SEND_STALL_CONTACT_ADMIN: WhatsApp is connected but cannot send messages. Your replies will not be delivered until an administrator links the device again.

WHATSAPP_REACHOUT_RESTRICTION.RESTRICTED_UNTIL: WhatsApp has temporarily restricted starting new conversations from this number until {time}.

PIN.ERROR: Could not update the pin. Please try again.

HISTORY_SYNC.HELP: Asks the phone for what came before. It has to be awake to answer, and it stays quiet once it has already sent this stretch.
HISTORY_SYNC.REQUESTED: Asked the phone for older messages. They appear here as it sends them.
HISTORY_SYNC.REQUESTED_BY_DATE: Asked the phone for older messages. Each one goes to the conversation from the date it was sent, so look for them in this contact's previous conversations.
HISTORY_SYNC.ERROR: Could not ask for older messages. Try again in a moment.
HISTORY_SYNC.EXHAUSTED: There is nothing older here. The rest of this conversation is only on the phone.

CONVERSATION.FILE_IS_EMPTY: This file is empty and cannot be sent

AUTOMATION.ASSIGNEE_NAME: Name of the agent the conversation is assigned to
AUTOMATION.BEFORE_ASSIGNEE_NAME: Agent the conversation was assigned to before the rule ran

CONVERSATION.WHATSAPP_NUMBER_MISSING_BANNER: This number had no WhatsApp when checked on {date}. Messages sent to it are not delivered.

HISTORY_MEDIA.PENDING: This file from the imported history has not been downloaded yet.
HISTORY_MEDIA.REQUESTED: Download requested. The file will show up here when it arrives.
HISTORY_MEDIA.ERROR: Could not request the download. Try again.
HISTORY_MEDIA.UNAVAILABLE: This file is no longer available on WhatsApp.
HISTORY_MEDIA.DOWNLOAD_ALL_REQUESTED: Downloading the history files of this conversation. They will show up as they arrive.
HISTORY_MEDIA.DOWNLOAD_ALL_ERROR: Could not request the history files. Try again.
